preconditions.description: The number of data centers n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of clients m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The day length h is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u_j < h for u_j in u)
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour u_j for data center j is between 0 and h-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i1 <= n and 1 <= c_i2 <= n and c_i1 != c_i2 for c_i1, c_i2 in clients)
preconditions.description: For each client i, the data center indices c_i1 and c_i2 are between 1 and n inclusive and c_i1 is not equal to c_i2.

postconditions.description: The number of data centers k to be included in the experiment is between 1 and n inclusive.
The list x contains exactly k distinct data center indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n for x_i in x)
postconditions.description: Each data center index x_i in the list x is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(u[c_i1 - 1] != u[c_i2 - 1] for c_i1, c_i2 in clients)
postconditions.description: After shifting the maintenance time for the data centers in x, the data of each client i is still accessible during any hour of the day.
